findings.rootCause: drawGraph builds full SVG even when CSS <=700px sets display:none
findings.userHarm: 360px phone pays DOM cost for 500 nodes and 500 paths but sees only cards
findings.counterexample: If Node DOM shows 0 svg and 0 path nodes at 360px initial, finding is false

findings.rootCause: No breakpoint-crossing re-render on resize or 200% zoom after initial render
findings.userHarm: Mobile-to-desktop stays card-only; desktop-to-mobile keeps ~21000-unit hidden SVG in DOM
findings.counterexample: If crossing 700px both ways swaps SVG presence without data loss, finding is false

findings.rootCause: SVG height max(300,88+70*max(evidenceCount,conclusionCount)) unbounded, ~21088 units for 200/300 nodes
findings.userHarm: Desktop giant graph causes extreme scroll, lost focus, motion discomfort, hard audit
findings.counterexample: If 500-node DOM stays contained with full card count and visible total, finding is false

findings.rootCause: ar locale may render technical IDs e1-e4/h-flow without LTR isolate and mix view copy with canonical data
findings.userHarm: Arabic RTL users see garbled IDs and cannot reliably cite evidence
findings.counterexample: If ar DOM wraps every ID in dir=ltr isolate and canonical JSON unchanged, finding is false

findings.rootCause: SVG and transcript cards can double-announce or lose SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS plus HUMAN_REVIEW semantics and focus on re-render
findings.userHarm: Screen-reader and keyboard users miss contradiction review or lose place
findings.counterexample: If SVG is labelled or hidden correctly and cards preserve relation text plus focus, finding is false

minimalPlan.change: Gate only SVG creation on matchMedia min-width 701px; always render node items and relation cards from same validated edges
minimalPlan.tradeoff: Adds viewport branch but saves hidden SVG work; needs correct re-render on crossing
minimalPlan.rolloutGate: Node DOM-contract: 360px has 0 svg/path, full cards; desktop has svg plus same cards; canonical JSON unchanged

minimalPlan.change: Add single matchMedia change plus debounced resize handler that re-renders display only on breakpoint crossing, preserves focus and scroll, no reanalysis or fetch
minimalPlan.tradeoff: Small listener complexity; must avoid duplicate handlers and focus loss
minimalPlan.rolloutGate: Offline resize both ways restores correct view with identical card count and zero network calls

minimalPlan.change: Harden audit-a11y: SVG role img with label and aria-hidden when hidden, cards as primary, LTR isolates for IDs, focus management, reduced-motion, scroll container for tall SVG with visible counts not truncation
minimalPlan.tradeoff: More markup and CSS, no inference change; tall graph still large but navigable
minimalPlan.rolloutGate: Node checks for isolates, labels, counts, focus target; no invented or dropped edges

offlineTests.expected: 0 svg paths, node items and relation cards equal validated counts
offlineTests.falsifier: Any path element present fails mobile gate

offlineTests.setup: Start 360px then expand to desktop and re-invoke display switch
offlineTests.expected: SVG with 900-unit width and valid-edge paths appears, cards unchanged
offlineTests.falsifier: Missing SVG or changed cards fails restore

offlineTests.expected: SVG removed or empty, cards remain full and canonical data intact
offlineTests.falsifier: Hidden 21000-unit SVG still in DOM fails cleanup

offlineTests.setup: Simulate 200% zoom reducing CSS pixels across 700px breakpoint
offlineTests.expected: Same as resize: view switches by breakpoint, no reanalysis
offlineTests.falsifier: Stale view after zoom fails breakpoint logic

offlineTests.setup: Synthetic 200 evidence plus 300 hypotheses with 500 valid edges
offlineTests.expected: 500 relation cards, path count equals valid edges, total disclosed
offlineTests.falsifier: Fewer cards or paths than valid edges means truncation or invention

offlineTests.setup: Inject malformed and dangling edges with unknown node refs
offlineTests.expected: Invalid edges skipped, valid cards and paths unchanged, warning count shown
offlineTests.falsifier: Crash, invented edge, or dropped valid card fails validation

offlineTests.setup: Set locale ar with fictional IDs and move focus through cards
offlineTests.expected: IDs wrapped in LTR isolate, copy translated, focus order intact
offlineTests.falsifier: Unisolated ID or focus loss fails RTL check

offlineTests.setup: Fire 20 rapid resizes across breakpoint with fetch spy
offlineTests.expected: One active listener, single final render, zero fetch or analysis calls
offlineTests.falsifier: Duplicate handlers or any network call fails safety

a11yChecklist: Simulated Node: cards readable single-column at 360px width; needs live 360px phone check
Simulated Node: layout switches at 200% zoom breakpoint; needs live browser 200% zoom check
Simulated DOM: hidden SVG has no AT announcement, desktop SVG has label; needs real screen-reader test
Simulated DOM: focus preserved and visible after breakpoint re-render; needs live keyboard test
Simulated media query: prefers-reduced-motion disables smooth scroll and transitions; needs live OS setting test
Simulated DOM: Arabic IDs in LTR isolates with en/fr/ar copy only; needs real Arabic screen-reader test
rejectedShortcuts: Never build SVG on mobile without restore: breaks zoom and resize to desktop audit.
Silently truncate giant graph to top N: hides evidence and breaks auditability.
Add heavy graph library or virtualization without transcript fallback: harms 360px use and accessibility.
Re-fetch or re-run analysis on resize or translate technical IDs: risks network cost and data corruption.
